narration: とはいえ、町の人の安心のため、問題となった個体を駆除すべく動きます。
scene: 2015年3月、冬の終わりで残雪のあるせたな町の上をドローン視点で進み、町はずれから山へ向かって一列で歩くハンターたち（小さく、顔は見えない）を追い越して、クマのいる山へ向かう。

fences.label: 静止画プロンプト（16:9・フォトリアル）:
fences.text: A high aerial drone view over the edge of the small coastal town of Setana, southwestern Hokkaido, in March, late winter: low houses with dark roofs, lingering patches of old snow in the fields and along the roads, bare trees, forested hills behind still partly white with snow, the grey-blue Sea of Japan at the edge of the frame. On a snowy farm track leading from the last houses toward the hills, a single file of five Japanese hunters in blaze-orange caps and vests with cased rifles on their backs walks away from the town toward the mountains, small in the frame, seen from above and behind, no face visible. Late-winter snow is intended in this scene. The camera looks forward and slightly down from about 60 metres above the track toward the hills. No readable signs, no real institution name, no crest, no emblem, no logo. Calm but resolute mood, soft overcast morning light, muted natural tones. Photorealistic, shot on RED camera. Documentary style. 16:9 aspect ratio. Generate 1 image.

The hunters stay small and seen from behind, no face visible. No cuts, no scene change, smooth steady movement. 8 seconds. Photorealistic, shot on RED camera. Documentary style.
